result.notes: I set other_conditions to null. 'Triggered only by demolition or conversion' describes landlord conduct, which is the event trigger already captured by event_only, not building coverage. I rewrote the summary to describe only the covered properties. requires_unknown_facts is false because the rule reaches ordinary rental property regardless of RSO or JCO status. The only source, D043, gives no unit-count, construction-date, owner or exemption limits for LAMC 47.06/47.07, so the section text should be checked.
